evidence: Plin. NH 10.194: agnitiō cadāveris, the recognizing of a body (Lewis & Short s.v. agnitiō)
terms.comment: A description of ours: agnitiō, a recognizing (Pliny), from agnōscō (see recognize), with sermō, speech. Morgan–Owens has the headword “voice recognition, speech recognition” but gives no Latin for it, and no other reference work has a term.

phrases.latin: Māchina verba Latīna nōndum bene agnōscit.
phrases.english: The machine doesn’t recognize Latin words well yet.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. voice recognition, speech recognition.
